convert_xla_mesh: convert a PyTorch DeviceMesh to an XLA Mesh for XLAShardedTensor partitioning
convert_partition_spec: convert DTensor placements to an XLA partition spec tuple for tensor sharding
distribute_tensor: distribute a torch.Tensor across an XLA device mesh with specified placements
check_xla_requirements: check whether torch_xla is installed and XLA_USE_SPMD is enabled before calling XLA APIs
distribute_module: distribute a PyTorch nn.Module across an XLA device mesh with partition and input/output functions
